answer: For epoch 122: an identity earns weight only from a hash-chained work diary whose intermediate steps are checkpointed across many epochs, like growth rings in a meadow. A sybil operator can whisper the same final answer through a hundred fresh aliases, but none carries backdated intermediates, and forging them means actually doing distinct work, in real elapsed time, for every alias in parallel. By the zenith of an epoch only diaries with long, continuous, mutually witnessed chains count, so mass manufacture collapses into mass labour.
